items.title: Why Positive-Pressure CTFAs Outperform Standalone Room Air Purifiers by 4x
items.subtitle: How introducing filtered outdoor air at +10 Pa prevents window smog infiltration while keeping indoor CO₂ below 600 ppm.
items.excerpt: Standalone room air purifiers only recirculate stale indoor air, allowing metabolic CO₂ to surge above 1,800 ppm while negative room pressure pulls outdoor PM2.5 through window cracks. Learn how Customized Treated Fresh Air (CTFA) units solve both challenges simultaneously.
items.author: IntelliGreen IAQ Research Desk

contentSections.heading: The Hidden Flaw of Recirculation-Only Air Purifiers
paragraphs: Most portable and cassette-style air purifiers operate strictly in closed-loop recirculation. While they trap airborne particles passing through their intake grilles, they do not bring a single cubic foot of fresh oxygen into the room. Within 45 minutes in an occupied conference room or bedroom, exhaled carbon dioxide (CO₂) climbs from 450 ppm to over 1,600 ppm—triggering cognitive fatigue, headaches, and drowsiness.

Even worse, exhaust fans in washrooms, pantries, and elevator shafts place commercial and residential floors under slight negative pressure. That negative pressure acts like a vacuum, continuously sucking raw outdoor PM2.5 smog through every hairline gap around windows and doors.

contentSections.heading: How Positive-Pressure CTFAs Create an Invisible Air Shield
paragraphs: IntelliGreen's Customized Treated Fresh Air (CTFA) units draw controlled outdoor air, pass it through a progressive G4 washable pre-filter, high-iodine honeycomb activated carbon bed, medical-grade HEPA H13 matrix, and UL 2998 active bipolar ionization, and inject it into the occupied room.

This continuous influx creates +8 to +15 Pascals of positive indoor pressure. Whenever a door opens or a window seal flexes, purified indoor air gently pushes outward—physically blocking raw street smog from entering while keeping indoor CO₂ locked below 650 ppm.

items.title: Recovering 78% of HVAC Thermal Energy with Cross-Flow Enthalpy ERV Cores
items.subtitle: Decoupling fresh-air ventilation requirements from chiller electricity penalties in tropical and composite climates.
items.excerpt: Bringing 45°C summer air or humid monsoon air directly into a building can spike chiller loads by 35%. Discover how diamond-matrix counter-crossflow ERV exchangers transfer sensible heat and latent moisture without air cross-contamination.
items.author: Dr. A. Verma

contentSections.heading: The Energy Penalty of Untreated Outdoor Ventilation
paragraphs: ASHRAE Standard 62.1 and WELL v2 mandate generous outdoor air ventilation rates per occupant. Yet in Indian summer and monsoon conditions, conditioning raw outdoor air accounts for nearly 40% of a commercial building's total HVAC electricity bill.

By routing outgoing 24°C conditioned exhaust air and incoming hot outdoor air through an IntelliGreen Cross-Flow ERV polymer membrane core, up to 78% of thermal enthalpy is exchanged automatically—slashing chiller tonnage requirements and earning direct LEED and IGBC credits.

items.title: Understanding UL 2998 Zero-Ozone Certification in Active Bipolar Ionization
items.subtitle: Why safety validation matters when deploying active in-room airborne pathogen neutralization.
items.excerpt: Not all ionizers are created equal. Legacy corona-discharge tubes produced unwanted ozone byproducts, whereas modern Needlepoint Bipolar Ionization (NPBI) is engineered and UL 2998 certified for zero ozone emission.
items.author: IntelliGreen Clinical IAQ Team

contentSections.heading: Active vs. Passive Air Disinfection in Critical Spaces
paragraphs: Passive filters like HEPA H13 only capture pollutants that travel through ductwork and reach the filter face. In high-occupancy hospitals, schools, and boardrooms, sneeze droplets and bio-aerosols circulate between occupants long before reaching a return grille.

UL 2998 certified Needlepoint Bipolar Ionization floods the breathing zone with >10 million H+ and O2- ions/cm³, clustering ultrafine particulates so they drop out of the breathing zone and inactivating enveloped viruses on contact—with verified zero ozone generation (<0.005 ppm).
